instructions: This repository uses espec. When the diff touches espec/changes/<change-name>/, read that folder's tech-proposal.md, delta specs under specs/, tasks.md and pull-request.md before explaining code. They are the intended behaviour.
Order the tour by the How to review section of pull-request.md when it exists: entry points, then the core, then tests.
Flag code that differs from the tech proposal or the delta specs without a matching row in the Proposal versus implementation table of pull-request.md.
Flag behaviour changes that no acceptance criterion (AC-n) or delta spec scenario describes, and acceptance criteria whose Verified by test is missing from the diff.
Flag edits to espec/specs/ outside an archive commit: main specs change only through /espec:archive and /espec:archive-clean.
